method: Synthetic offline copy removes previewMode only to admit production Tripod/Ray and individual weapon probes. Actual level contains scenery and wildlife only. Guns: production actual pitched muzzles at zero/full recoil, per-species 1-unit bins. Arcs: production closest terminal, centre LOS and deterministic production facing-side surface sampling at 4-unit midpoint bins (eligibility held only as a quadrature approximation over each bin). No damage, waves, budget or simultaneous adjacent-defence claim.

geometry.sampling: Clearance: 1-unit canonical route poses and endpoints, actual occupied-part vertex envelopes against exact static cuboids and complete defence motion envelopes. Coverage: 1-unit midpoint bins, both actual muzzle rays at zero/full recoil; base/upgrade1 guns only. Ideal120 is missile range geometry, not a flight prediction.

method.sceneryScope: Every retained scenery placement, without a distance filter; exact occupied cuboids from SceneryVisibility.
method.continuousCheck: Project each occupied cuboid onto the exact ground plane and convex-clip against the full 24x24 ground rectangle. Any overlap area above 1e-8 square world units fails. Ray origins alone use a0.01-unit lift to avoid ground self-contact.

limitations: Checks scenery and terrain only. Existing defences, moving enemies, wildlife and effects are excluded.
Checks the default overview direction and ground footprint; arbitrary camera rotations and hypothetical future model heights are outside this audit.
The ray grid alone is sampled; the separate continuous projected-cuboid check covers unsampled slivers. Zero-area edge tangency is not counted as an obstruction.
This is geometric visibility, not a GPU pixel, contrast, tactical coverage or weapon line-of-sight test. Source geometry and shared visibility transforms must remain consistent.
